log: `Rules/Player/turn-start.ts` kept which cities were in civil disorder or celebrating in two module-level `Set<City>`s. No `Game` slot held them, so a save never recorded them, and every game in the page shared them (civ-clone/web-renderer#121).

They are now `PendingEffect`s in `game.pendingEffects`, the same way `civ1-government` records a revolution under way: `civ1-city-happiness:civil-disorder` and `civ1-city-happiness:leader-celebration`, each targeting the `City`. Discharging one emits `city:order-restored` or `city:leader-celebration-ended`. `pendingEffects` is already a `state` slot and `PendingEffect` already saves generically, so the save format doesn't change, and older saves load as before, with no statuses recorded.
`Rules/City/destroyed.ts` drops a razed city's statuses, so a `$ref` doesn't keep it in the save.
